messages:
Alice Chen: FYI ran the private deploy smoke today and hit decrypt errors for the model shard keys after the RBAC tweak we merged this morning. repeating error: 'access denied for kms:Decrypt'
Ben P.: ugh, thanks for the report. which change exactly? the service-account->role binding?
Alice Chen: yeah, the change removed iam:Decrypt for the 'redwood-infer-node' role per least-privilege work. It looks like the runtime tried to fetch the cluster-wide wrapping key then KMS returned AccessDenied.
Carmen Ruiz: can you paste the full log line? might need to check if it's the wrapping key or the per-tenant KEKs
Alice Chen: log snippet:
```
2026-03-19T21:03:14Z runtime[shard-3]: ERROR fetchKey: kms.Decrypt failed: AccessDenied: User: serviceAccount:redwood-infer-node@proj not authorized to perform: cloudkms.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt
```
Davinder Singh: that looks like the service account is missing useToDecrypt on that cryptoKeyVersion. RBAC change probably scoped the role to project but not the key resource.
Ben P.: quick triage plan: 1) revert RBAC patch if needed 2) grant `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` scoped to the KEK resource 3) re-run smoke 4) audit logs for who/what called KMS
Carmen Ruiz: + also need to check audit logging config in private deployments — ensure KMS admin events are forwarded to customer audit bucket and sent to sec-ingest.
Alice Chen: agree. I can patch a scoped grant for the test cluster to unblock. question: do we prefer temporary broad grant or resource-scoped role?
Davinder Singh: resource-scoped for safety. but for immediate unblock, a short TTL binding in iam that we remove after test is fine. add an audit entry for who added it.
Ben P.: temporary binding created with expiration 2h. tag the PR with "exp-in-2h" and leave a comment.
sec-bot: ACTION_LOG: iamBinding created by Ben P. on 2460123501 for serviceAccount:redwood-infer-node@proj -> roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter (expires 2460124201) :thumbsup:
Alice Chen: unblocked locally, runtime can decrypt and shards load. smoke ok so far.
Carmen Ruiz: next: vuln triage angle — was this change part of a broader migration? could there be callers that lost decrypt ability leading to silent failures?
Davinder Singh: yes possible. My recommendation: run a grep across recent deploy logs for 'AccessDenied.*cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt' and also query Cloud Audit Logs for KMS failures in last 48h.
Ben P.: I'll run the audit log query and post results here. also let's add an automated alert: if KMS Decrypt error rate > 0.1% in 5m, page ops-oncall.
Alice Chen: created GH issue: infra/priv-deploy#842 - 'KMS RBAC: ensure resource-scoped decrypt role + alerting + audit-forwarding' with action items and owners.
Carmen Ruiz: owners: Ben (rbac fix + alert), Davinder (audit queries + runbook), Alice (smoke validation + PR). I'll update the private-deploy hardening doc with the playbook steps.
Davinder Singh: quick runbook snippet to add to docs:
```
1) Check logs: grep 'AccessDenied.*useToDecrypt' /var/log/redwood/runtime.log
2) Query audit: resource.type="k8s_cluster" protoPayload.methodName:"v1.cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt" severity:ERROR
3) If present: temporary grant resource-scoped `roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter` to service account, record IAM binding ID
4) Validate: run shard smoke and watch for Decrypt errors
5) Revoke binding when fixed and document in incident log
```
Ben P.: I'll attach the audit query results in 10m. tagging @Carmen Ruiz for doc review.
Alice Chen: thanks y'all. one more thing — let's ensure the RBAC PR template requires a KMS impact checklist before merge (who needs decrypt, does role scope include key resource). saved me some gray hairs. :sweat_smile:
Carmen Ruiz: agreed. pushing checklist to repo: infra/.github/PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE/kms-checklist.md
sec-bot: INCIDENT_NOTE: short outage avoided. incident severity: S1 if not caught. logged to sec-ops-diary with incident id sec-2026-03-19-01
Davinder Singh: closing loop once Ben posts audit hits.
Ben P.: posted results: 7 failed decrypt attempts across two tenants between 20:58-21:03 UTC, all from redwood-infer-node SA. no indication of exploit, looks configuration-only.
Alice Chen: closing for now. follow-ups tracked in infra/priv-deploy#842. thanks everyone. :heart:
